name: ConditionTransaction

fieldMeaning.rootEventId: stable shared causing action identity; not new RNG on decision
fieldMeaning.conditionEventId: stable target/effect identity; avoids applying one Use to every effect
fieldMeaning.sourceHeroId: authoritative causing campaign Hero, not the recipient by default
fieldMeaning.sourceSkillId: source Skill, or explicit other-source attribution if that scope is proven
fieldMeaning.targetUnitId: original actual target, immutable on Use/Decline/reload
fieldMeaning.baseMagnitude: source amount, may be null; separate from duration
fieldMeaning.baseDuration: only authoritative independently bound source turns
fieldMeaning.effectiveDuration: source-bound duration changes only; unresolved ordering cannot run
fieldMeaning.resistanceOutcome: not-rolled or frozen original roll/outcome/immunity/categorical decision, including provenance

proposedGranularity: Conditional design: one causing-action root with one child per actual target/Condition; adoption requires source-backed declaration/selection ordering
invariant: No negative from mere applyEffects presence on a miss
One Use binds one selected Condition, never all skill effects
Distinct physical copies share root state
Persist processed physical instances and Use/Decline decisions
Persist already rolled resistance; never reroll on reload
currentRuntimeCandidate: PendingBattleAction freezes hit/crit/baseDamage/target; statusEffectEvents persists completed effects/blocked results, but neither is a pending attributed Condition declaration transaction
activeContinuation: Future only: freeze -> engine opportunity -> Use/Decline -> commit/resume exactly once; exact commit point unresolved
